{{Quote|But Master Altis doesn't subscribe to those views about family. Does that place him on the dark side? What about the Jedi who founded our Order? They didn't ban attachment. Does that mean everything we are today is built on a foundation of darkness? Why did we decide it was suddenly a bad thing? And are there other Force-users on the light side? I've never met any. Surely they exist?|Bagar Nei-Leit inquires into the Order's policies on attachment during a philosophy class during the Clone Wars|<ref name="CWNP" />}}
'''Bagar Nei-Leit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Bagar Nei-Leit was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During a class dedicated to the philosophy behind the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] Nei-Leit inquired about the nature of the Order's ban of attachment. During the discussion, Nei-Leit asked if [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis's]] views made him a [[darksider]].<ref name="CWNP" />
